text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s t-o s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t f-e-e-d-b-a-c-k, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a f-o-r-g-e d r-e-v-i-e-w l-o-g t-h-a-t b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m's i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d e-d-i-t-o-r-i-a-l d-e-c-i-s-i-o-n m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a, l-e-a-v-i-n g a t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d r-e-j-e-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d t-h-a-t i-g-n-o-r-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d c-l-o-n-e r-e-v-i-e-w s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s u-s-i-n-g p-r-o-x-y s-e-r-v-e-r-s, l-e-a-v-i-n g i-p a-d-d-r-e-s l-o-g-s a-s a-c-o-m-p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n g t-h-e r-a-t-e l-i-m-i-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d t-h-e s-e-l-e-c-t-i-o-n a-l-g-o-r-i-t-h-m w-e-i-g-h-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n g a m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d c-o-n-f-i-g u-r-l f-i-l-e t-h-a t c-o-n-t-a-i-n-e-d h-a-r-d-c-o-d-e-d b-i-a-s p-a-r-a-m-e-t-e-r-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-h-a-n-g-e c-o-n-t-r-o-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e t-h-e p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w a-s-s-i-g-n-m-e-n t m-o-d-u-l-e, l-e-a-v-i-n g a f-o-r-g-e d d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n l-o-g t-h-a t l-a-c-k-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
